job:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Builds a run-length encoding of an E/S direction string and then prints a reconstructed E/S sequence, choosing the output layout according to the parity of the total number of direction changes and the initial run direction." job]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize ggg to the constant value of 'E' XOR 'S' (22), goodp to -1, movesp to 0, and cur to 'E'. RESULT initial_state]
            [COMMAND Read an integer n and a string in_str from standard input using scanf("%d%s", &n, in_str). RESULT input_data]
            [COMMAND Set n to 2*n - 2. RESULT n]
            [COMMAND Set moves[0] to 0. RESULT moves_initialized]
            [COMMAND For each i from 0 to n-1: if in_str[i] is not equal to cur, toggle cur with cur = cur ^ ggg, set moves[movesp+1] to 1, and increment movesp; otherwise increment moves[movesp] and set goodp to movesp when the condition ((moves[0] != 0 and i is odd) or (moves[0] == 0 and i is even)) is true. RESULT loop_state]
            [COMMAND Set parity to movesp after the loop. RESULT parity]
            [COMMAND If moves[0] is not 0, increment parity by 1. RESULT parity]
            [COMMAND Branch on parity % 2: if it equals 0 execute the even-parity alternative flow; otherwise execute the odd-parity alternative flow, writing the final E/S sequence. RESULT printed_output]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: parity % 2 == 0]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize En to 0. For i from 0 to movesp inclusive with step 2, add moves[i] to En. RESULT En]
            [COMMAND If moves[0] == 0, print En 'E' characters followed by n - En 'S' characters; otherwise print n - En 'S' characters followed by En 'E' characters. RESULT printed_output]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: parity % 2 != 0]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize s1, s2, e1, e2 to 0. Sum moves[i] into e1 for even i from 0 while i < goodp; sum moves[i] into s1 for odd i from 1 while i < goodp; sum moves[i] into e2 for even i from 2*((goodp+1)/2) while i <= movesp; sum moves[i] into s2 for odd i from 2*(goodp/2)+1 while i <= movesp. RESULT group_sums]
            [COMMAND If moves[0] == 0, print 'E' with a for loop starting at i = -1, continuing while i < e1, and incrementing i by 1; then print 'S' with a for loop starting at i = 0, continuing while i < s1+s2, and incrementing i by 1; then print 'E' with a for loop starting at i = 1, continuing while i < e2, and incrementing i by 1. Otherwise, print 'S' with a for loop starting at i = -1, continuing while i < s1, and incrementing i by 1; then print 'E' with a for loop starting at i = 0, continuing while i < e1+e2, and incrementing i by 1; then print 'S' with a for loop starting at i = 1, continuing while i < s2, and incrementing i by 1. RESULT printed_output]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
